## Checked

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `format:check`, `typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes, if a generated site or the template changed
- [ ] New behavior has a test at the right level
- [ ] Every new export has a TSDoc comment
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under Unreleased, if a user would notice
